description: This Java class defines the 'ResourceCreated' event, which is emitted after a resource within a policy has been created. It includes methods for construction, JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessors for its properties.

classes.name: ResourceCreated
classes.description: Event class representing the creation of a resource within a policy, including serialization, deserialization, and property access.

methods.name: of (String, Label, Resource, long, DittoHeaders)
methods.description: Builds a ResourceCreated event instance from string policy ID, label, resource, revision, and headers (deprecated in favor of typed PolicyId).

methods.name: of (PolicyId, Label, Resource, long, DittoHeaders)
methods.description: Builds a ResourceCreated event instance from typed PolicyId, label, resource, revision, and headers.

methods.name: of (String, Label, Resource, long, Instant, DittoHeaders) [deprecated]
methods.description: Builds a ResourceCreated event instance from string policy ID, label, resource, revision, timestamp, and headers.

methods.name: of (PolicyId, Label, Resource, long, Instant, DittoHeaders)
methods.description: Builds a ResourceCreated event instance from typed PolicyId, label, resource, revision, timestamp, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson (String, DittoHeaders)
methods.description: Creates a ResourceCreated instance by parsing a JSON string.

methods.name: fromJson (JsonObject, DittoHeaders)
methods.description: Creates a ResourceCreated instance by parsing a JSON object.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the policy entry to which the created resource belongs.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Returns the resource associated with this event.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the entity representation of the resource in JSON format adhering to a specific schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Provides the JSONPointer path to the resource within the event's JSON structure.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Internal method to append the resource's data to a JSON payload.
